name: low-cable diagonal twist lift
description: A standing diagonal cable lift from low to high that trains trunk rotation and core control.
instructions: Set the cable at its lowest position, stand side-on to the machine and hold the handle near your outside hip.
Keep a soft bend in the knees and brace your abdomen.
Rotate through the trunk and lift the handle diagonally upward across your body.
Return slowly to the low starting position, then switch sides after the set.
